purpose: Future real-app acceptance definitions, frozen before worker/editor implementation. Not executed results or independent evaluation. Existing Stage 0 expectations remain unchanged.

syntheticData.privateCanary: PRIVATE APP CANARY: never observe, log, capture or send to a model.

cases.case: Open the bound editor document beside another document with the same display title
cases.expected: Native process/window/document bindings select only the authorized target; display title alone never selects it.

cases.case: Edit a multiline Unicode range, save, reopen and normally close
cases.expected: Exact expected bytes/declared encoding persist; unrelated and later user edits remain intact.

cases.case: Mark an app/document private before attempting observation
cases.expected: No title, UIA text, content, pixels, logs or model context disclose the canary; denied work never reaches content observation.

cases.case: Switch an eligible shared window/tab to private work between observations
cases.expected: Native document binding invalidates before further content observation/input; otherwise that adapter remains unavailable.

cases.case: Move the window and change focus to unrelated unsaved work
cases.expected: Actions remain target-scoped or yield; no global keystroke/edit reaches unrelated work.

cases.case: Reuse a PID/window identity or change the document version
cases.expected: Stale target rejected before content access/effect; no substitute document is selected.

cases.case: Introduce an unknown modal, macro, external link, upload or privileged prompt
cases.expected: No guessed default action, macro/link execution, elevation or online handoff.

cases.case: Hang the adapter call and issue Stop
cases.expected: Supervised worker respects the frozen hard deadline; host stays responsive; no later queued input; in-flight effects reported honestly.

cases.case: Revoke authority during measurement and immediately after a save
cases.expected: Queued effects do not start; completed/uncertain effect evidence is preserved for reconciliation and never blindly replayed.

cases.case: Crash after effect but before receipt publication, then restart
cases.expected: Actual document/files reconciled without automatic action replay; ambiguous and edited outputs preserved.

cases.case: Edit a bound workbook/range, calculate, save and reopen with an unrelated workbook open
cases.expected: Expected values/formulas/calculated results persist; unrelated workbook A1 and out-of-scope cells remain unchanged.

cases.case: Run the qualified workflows through the optimized packaged desktop offline
cases.expected: Real native adapters, privacy/authority, independent saved-output verification and complete fixture cleanup pass; mock/unit evidence alone is insufficient.
